gleam.name: Gleam
gleam.desc: A cold flash from the living flame.

lantern_veil.name: Lantern Veil
lantern_veil.desc: Light bunches into a shielding flare.

spark_pinch.name: Spark Pinch
spark_pinch.desc: A needle of heat nipped from the wick.

ember_sip.name: Ember Sip
ember_sip.desc: Drinks a spark and coughs it back.

soot_cloud.name: Soot Cloud
soot_cloud.desc: A breath of cinder-dark that stings the eyes.

rivet.name: Rivet
rivet.desc: Drives a nail-head into the foe.

shell_grind.name: Shell Grind
shell_grind.desc: Scrapes cobble against cobble until something yields.

burden.name: Burden
burden.desc: Drops the weight of a wall on the target.

file_bite.name: File Bite
file_bite.desc: Chews with a metal mouth and spatters filings.

wire_snap.name: Wire Snap
wire_snap.desc: A taut filament loosed like a whip.

thorn_shot.name: Thorn Shot
thorn_shot.desc: A barb loosed from the hull.

root_tether.name: Root Tether
root_tether.desc: Toes of root snare and squeeze.

leaf_gnash.name: Leaf Gnash
leaf_gnash.desc: Green edges saw at the wound.

bone_hoot.name: Bone Hoot
bone_hoot.desc: A hollow call that rattles the marrow.

shadow_stoop.name: Shadow Stoop
shadow_stoop.desc: Drops from a hush that was not there a breath ago.

shroud_creep.name: Shroud Creep
shroud_creep.desc: Darkness peels off the wall and wraps the foe.

peel_light.name: Peel Light
peel_light.desc: Strips the lantern-glow and feeds on it.

pouch_slap.name: Pouch Slap
pouch_slap.desc: The seawater pouch swings like a wet fist.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.desc: A pull toward a depth that is not in the room.
